name: r6-contact-pair-heart
description: THE CONTACT PAIR v2, arm 3 of 3 — `noDamage: FALSE` and ONE GRANT, which is the field that moves. `health` is not a flag: `Bot.applyGrant` does `Player.hitsMax = Player.hitsMax + 1` over `hitsMaxDef` 3, so this arm walks into the same trap with FOUR hearts and the same three hits at 48 / 72 / 100 leave it standing where the live arm died. The death that does come is a FOURTH hit at 123, and the arm is the direct witness that `hits >= hitsMax` reads a run value rather than a constant — R4's 'the one claim on the ladder whose truth value FLIPS', driven. It is also the only arm that witnesses the i-frame SUPPRESSION from the enemy's side: one tick of overlap inside an open window, paying nothing.
